description: This file defines the ContentFieldsProvider class which implements IContentFieldProvider. It provides mappings and methods for handling various content field types in GraphQL, including retrieving field definitions, checking for fields and indexes, and generating index descriptors.

classes.name: ContentFieldsProvider
classes.description: Provides GraphQL field mappings and resolvers for content fields in OrchardCore.

classes.name: FieldTypeDescriptor
classes.description: Holds metadata for each content field type, including description, GraphQL types, accessor functions, and index info.

methods.name: GetField
methods.description: Returns a GraphQL FieldType for a given content part field definition.

methods.name: HasField
methods.description: Checks if a field exists in the mappings.

methods.name: GetFieldIndex
methods.description: Generates an index descriptor for a content part field.

methods.name: HasFieldIndex
methods.description: Checks if a field has an associated index.
